result:
The proposed answer is not the minimum, because a much smaller value is easy to achieve.

Color every edge of a spanning tree (for example, a path through all 2025 cities) with company X. The condition only applies when two edges at a city have different colors, so with one color it holds vacuously. The graph is connected, and max(n_X, n_Y, n_Z) = 2024.

Since 2024 < 455625, the claimed minimum is wrong. The solution only considered complete tripartite constructions and never compared against sparse ones. Its construction is valid but far from optimal.

VERDICT: REJECT
